cost: No surprise acquisition or cloud actions
summary: A coding demo, not a timed fresh-laptop installation. Stop or label recorded fallback evidence when a prerequisite or live check is unavailable.

steps.title: 00:00-02:00: explain readiness and daily checks
steps.where: VS Code › Terminal › Workstation onboarding agent
do: Show already observed Verify/daily checks and distinguish expected pre-setup gaps from post-setup acceptance.
Use the exact onboarding prompt; never approve agent setup/repair/Restore/authentication.
steps.see: Accurate boundaries and observed results or clearly dated recorded fallback.

steps.title: 02:00-06:00: extend EMI with focused tests
do: Use extend-emi-api: exact money, preserved rounded EMI, prepayment after regular payment, shorter tenure, exact final settlement.
Require focused invalid/rounding tests with existing dependencies; unfinished work stays unfinished.
steps.see: A scoped diff and truthful checks, not automatic launch or a claimed migration.

steps.title: 06:00-08:00: operator runs an existing image
do: Use an image from an earlier explicitly confirmed Restore ContainerImages stage and an already approved runtime.
Human starts it; a second terminal checks health and the synthetic EMI request.
steps.warn: Missing/broken runtime or image means NOT RUN; no live repair or policy-bypassing fallback.
steps.see: Actual response or explicitly labelled recorded evidence.

steps.title: 08:00-10:30: prepare existing-AKS files only
do: Use prepare-for-azure with real image/namespace inputs and existing AKS/ACR.
Explain current-main, test, digest and independent approval gates; do not dispatch, authenticate or provision.
steps.see: Static review with missing inputs and live-evidence gaps made explicit.

steps.title: 10:30-13:00: review non-serving Go training text
do: Identify raw query logging and internal-error disclosure in the fixture, with line references and safe alternatives.
Contrast safe serving tests; never copy the fixture defects into an app or image.
steps.see: Actionable review and truthful checks, not a deliberate live vulnerability.

steps.title: 13:00-15:00: GitHub review, optional modernization assessment
steps.where: Source Control › GitHub Pull Requests view
do: Only authorized stage/commit/publish/PR actions; retain template and actual check results.
Java 11/Boot 2.7 is explicit assessment only if rehearsed; never upgrade by hand or add legacy to default CI/deployment.
steps.see: A reviewed handoff; setup, cloud approval and live deployment remain separate.
